title: Structured Log Entry Schema
description: JSON Schema for a single line of Bloqr Dashboard's structured JSON log output (one JSON object per line, newline-delimited, in the app's rolling .jsonl log files). Consistent across bloqr-dashboard, rules-compiler-dotnet, and any other .NET app in this repo that adopts structured JSON logging per issue #275.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp the log event was emitted, ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format

messageTemplate.description: The structured message template (Serilog-style, with {PropertyName} placeholders) before substitution

message.description: The rendered, human-readable log message with template placeholders substituted

exception.description: Full exception details (type, message, stack trace) when the log event is associated with an exception

sourceContext.description: The logger's source context, typically the fully-qualified type name that emitted the event

application.description: Name of the application/process that emitted the log entry, e.g. 'bloqr-dashboard', 'rules-compiler-dotnet'

properties.description: Additional structured properties captured with the log event (arbitrary key/value pairs)
